resubmit_4x5.transcription_error_caught: The transcript says PENTAFLEX, which is not a camera. Chinatown was shot on Panavision PANAFLEX bodies with anamorphic lenses at 2.35:1. GENERAL LESSON: do not lift apparatus names straight from an Opus transcript into a caption. Verify any proper noun naming hardware.
